texts.label: new markets (reference good example)
texts.text: **Growth now comes from new markets.** Sales rose again this period, led by the Nordics, while core markets held flat.

texts.label: returning customers
texts.text: **Returning customers are the gap.** Almost all active customers are new, and the biggest spenders carry a large share of sales.

texts.label: bigger baskets
texts.text: **Fewer orders, bigger baskets.** Order count dipped while the average order grew, keeping total sales steady.

texts.label: category concentration
texts.text: **Electronics carries the product mix.** It leads every other category in sales, and the gap to the rest keeps widening.

texts.label: rough size in words (prompt phrasing)
texts.text: **Audio and video now carry the store.** They bring in about a third of sales, and their sales roughly doubled compared with last period.

texts.label: executive summary
texts.text: **Summary:** Net Sales were $4.2M in Q3 2026, up 12%. Key takeaways: Electronics leads with 38% share; returns fell to 2.1%. Things to watch: inventory in Furniture is rising, and discounts may erode margin next quarter.

texts.label: chart walk-through
texts.text: **Sales overview.** Total Sales Trend shows sales in the low $100Ks, Net Sales by Product Category shows Audio & Video leading, and Order Breakdown shows most orders are Processed.

texts.label: hedged figures (real output)
texts.text: **Solid top-line scale** Total Sales are about $270M this period, supported by a customer base of roughly 1.2K Total Customers.

texts.text: **Sales mix:** Audio & Video Accessories drive ~40% of Net Sales, and most orders are Processed.

texts.text: This page shows sales, orders and customers for the online store. Sales rose while orders held flat.
